notes: M21 G2 spec: Goremand. 'As an additional cost, sacrifice a creature' (the only own creature, bear, goes). 'When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature': the OPPONENT chooses which; here the opponent answers its choice with opp_bear (its smaller creature, the later-created one), so opp_bear dies and opp_giant stays. Fails if the engine picks for the opponent (the L-27 / B-53 chooser gap).
